metadata.notes: Omnidirectional Soft Sleeve Actuator (4-chamber bellows). Full device has 4 independent pressure channels (~3 independent DOF). This record describes one actuation mode; see also ossa_* siblings. Rest length 120 mm from the source paper (added 9 Jul 2026). Mode: all 4 chambers under vacuum (-90 kPa). Blocked force not separately reported for vacuum mode.
